name: EngageBlog
elevator_pitch: For content teams struggling to maximize their content's impact, ContentReach is a blog posting app that provides advanced analytics and seamless video integration. Unlike generic blogging platforms, ContentReach empowers teams with actionable insights and diverse media support, ensuring their content not only gets published but truly resonates and expands its audience.
problem_statement: Content teams face challenges in effectively distributing their content and understanding its performance, leading to suboptimal content reach and engagement.
solution: ContentReach provides a comprehensive blog posting platform with integrated analytics and robust video support, enabling content teams to publish diverse content, track its performance, and optimize strategies for improved reach.
vision: To be the leading platform for content teams, empowering them to create, publish, and amplify high-performing content that consistently expands their audience and achieves their strategic goals.
competitors: WordPress, Medium, HubSpot Blog, Ghost, Squarespace.
success_metrics: Increased content reach (e.g., page views, unique visitors), higher engagement rates (e.g., comments, shares), improved content team efficiency, and growth in video content consumption.
design_principles: The design prioritizes efficiency and clarity, enabling content teams to quickly publish and manage diverse content, especially video. It emphasizes data-driven insights through an intuitive analytics dashboard to improve content reach and performance.
sitemap:
- Dashboard (/) - Main dashboard for content overview and quick actions.
- Login (/login) - User login page.
- Create Post (/create-post) - Page for creating and editing new blog posts.
- Media Library (/media-library) - Central repository for managing media assets, including video uploads.
- Analytics Dashboard (/analytics) - Dashboard displaying content performance and audience insights.
- Admin Panel (/admin) - Administrative section for managing app settings and users.
  - User Management (/admin/users) - Manage user accounts and roles.
- API Integrations (/admin/api-integrations) - Admin panel for managing API integrations.
- System Settings (/admin/system-settings) - Admin panel for reviewing system settings related to scalability and security.
- System Reports (/admin/system-reports) - Admin panel for generating and viewing system performance and health reports.
navigation_design:
**Content Manager Navigation:**
*   **Dashboard**: Accessible from `/` after login, providing an overview of content performance and quick access to publishing tools.
*   **Create Post**: Direct link to `/create-post` for drafting and publishing new blog entries, including video content.
*   **Media Library**: Link to `/media-library` for uploading and managing all media assets.
*   **Analytics**: Dedicated section at `/analytics` for in-depth content performance metrics and insights.
*   **Logout**: Option to securely log out of the application.

**Admin Navigation:**
*   **Admin Panel**: Entry point to administrative functions, potentially at `/admin`.
*   **User Management**: Direct access to `/admin/users` for managing user accounts and roles.
*   **Logout**: Option to securely log out of the application.

key_features.feature_description: Provides insights into content performance, audience engagement, and reach.
Enables seamless uploading, embedding, and management of video content.
Intuitive interface for creating, editing, and publishing blog posts.
Admin tools for managing content team members and their roles.
For connecting with other marketing and analytics tools.
Infrastructure to handle growing content volume and ensure data protection.
Tools for tracking application health and generating performance reports.

user_stories.title: Create and Publish Text Post

user_story.i_want: to create and publish a blog post with text
user_story.so_that: I can share written content with my audience

acceptance_criteria: Only content_team_member can access /create-post.
User can enter and format text content using a rich text editor.
User can save a post as a draft.
User can preview the post before publishing.
User can publish the post, making it live.
Published posts are visible on the blog.
The data model stores approved and the application uses it as described in this story.
The data model stores profile completed and the application uses it as described in this story.

user_stories.title: Edit Existing Post

user_story.i_want: to edit an already published post
user_story.so_that: I can correct errors or update information

acceptance_criteria: Only content_team_member can edit published posts.
User can select a published post from a list and enter edit mode.
User can modify text and media within the post.
User can save changes, which are immediately reflected on the live blog.

user_stories.title: Upload Video Content

user_story.so_that: I can include rich media in my blog posts

acceptance_criteria: Only content_team_member can access /media-library.
The app provides an upload UI for video data, accepting MP4, MOV, and AVI formats, and visibly confirms a successful import.
User can add a title and description to the uploaded video.
Uploaded videos are stored in the media library.
The data model stores duration and the application uses it as described in this story.
The data model stores url and the application uses it as described in this story.

user_stories.title: Embed Video in Post

user_story.i_want: to embed uploaded videos into my blog posts
user_story.so_that: I can create engaging multimedia content

acceptance_criteria: Only content_team_member can embed videos.
User can select an uploaded video from the media library within the post editor.
The selected video is correctly embedded and displayed in the post preview.
Embedded videos play correctly on the published blog post.

user_stories.title: Admin Login

user_story.i_want: to securely log in to the application
user_story.so_that: I can manage users and application settings

acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /admin/dashboard.
User can enter email and password on the login page.
Successful login redirects admin to /admin/dashboard.
Failed login attempts display an error message.

user_stories.title: Manage Content Team Members

user_story.i_want: to add, edit, and remove content_team_member accounts
user_story.so_that: I can control who can publish content

acceptance_criteria: Only admin can access /admin/users.
Admin can view a list of existing content_team_member accounts.
Admin can create a new content_team_member account with a name, email, and password.
Admin can edit an existing content_team_member's details.
Admin can deactivate or delete a content_team_member account.
The data model stores first name and the application uses it as described in this story.
The data model stores last name and the application uses it as described in this story.

user_stories.title: User Logout

user_story.i_want: to log out of the application

acceptance_criteria: User can click a logout button.
Successful logout redirects the user to /login.
After logout, the user cannot access protected routes without re-authenticating.

user_stories.title: View Content Performance Metrics

user_story.i_want: to view key performance metrics for my content
user_story.so_that: I can understand what resonates with my audience

acceptance_criteria: Only content_team_member can access /analytics.
Dashboard displays total views, unique visitors, and engagement rate for all content.
Metrics are presented in an easy-to-understand visual format (e.g., charts, graphs).
User can see performance metrics for individual posts.

user_stories.title: Filter Analytics Data

user_story.i_want: to filter analytics data by date range and content type
user_story.so_that: I can analyze specific campaigns or content formats

acceptance_criteria: Only content_team_member can filter analytics data.
User can select a custom date range to view data.
User can filter data to show only video posts or text posts.
Filtered data updates the dashboard in real-time.
The data model stores event type and the application uses it as described in this story.

user_stories.title: Connect to Marketing Tools

user_story.i_want: to integrate the blog app with external marketing tools
user_story.so_that: I can automate content distribution and campaign tracking

acceptance_criteria: Only admin can access /admin/integrations.
Admin can view a list of available marketing tool integrations (e.g., Mailchimp, HubSpot).
Admin can configure API keys or authentication tokens for selected integrations.
Successful integration is confirmed with a status indicator.

user_stories.title: System Health Monitoring

user_story.i_want: to monitor the application's health and performance
user_story.so_that: I can ensure continuous availability and identify issues proactively

acceptance_criteria: System generates alerts for critical errors (e.g., server downtime, database connection issues).
System logs application performance metrics (e.g., response times, resource utilization).
Monitoring data is accessible to admin via a dedicated dashboard (e.g., /admin/monitoring).

user_stories.title: Data Backup and Restore

user_story.so_that: I can recover content and user data in case of data loss

acceptance_criteria: System performs automated daily backups of all application data.
Backup files are stored securely and redundantly.
admin can initiate a data restore process from a recent backup.

user_stories.title: Role-Based Access Control

user_story.so_that: users can only access features and data relevant to their assigned roles

acceptance_criteria: content_team_member cannot access /admin routes.
admin has full access to all application features and data.
Unauthorized access attempts are logged and blocked.

phasing.rationale: This phase delivers the core functionality for content teams to create, publish, and manage video blog posts, along with essential user administration. It provides a complete, demonstrable product for initial user adoption.

Building on the MVP, this phase introduces critical analytics for content performance, enables integration with external tools, and enhances platform stability and security for broader impact and growth.
